in_hebrew.name: Griffis
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Griffis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'grypheus', meaning 'griffin'. In mythology, griffins are creatures with the body of a lion and the head and wings of an eagle, symbolizing strength, courage, and fearlessness.

in_greek.name: Griffis

in_greek.long_meaning: Griffis είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'grypheus', meaning 'griffin'. In mythology, griffins are creatures with the body of a lion and the head and wings of an eagle, symbolizing strength, courage, and fearlessness.
